review_notes: I read the whole file. I looked for declarations that compete with an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. The matrix-furniture section (transposeInv3 lemmas, transposeInv3Hom, transposeInvN_map, the Weyl/unipotent identities) has no Mathlib counterpart. A grep of Mathlib for a transpose-inverse on GL found only an unrelated card-counting equivalence in GeneralLinearGroup/Card.lean. The definitions projAt, embAt, embS, projS, awayPart, w₀At, slotD, slotMat, kkAt and modY are local specialisations. embS and projS are built from Mathlib's MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod and MonoidHom.pi. LocProd is an abbrev for a Pi type. The norm_psi* lemmas are standalone theorems, which the rubric excludes. The repo has several overlapping definitions of its own (unipotent versus unipotentGL2, transposeInv3 versus transposeInvN), and the file bridges them with unipotent_eq_unipotentGL2. Those overlaps are between repo declarations, not with Mathlib, so they are out of scope for this rubric. I found no avoidable Mathlib duplicate with a demonstrated cost.
